theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiNAB_excess_le_sqrt
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N) (e : Rn N) (S : Set (Rn N)), μ S < ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → ‖e‖ = 1 → ∫ y in S, ‖ν y - e‖ ∂μ ≤ (μ S).toReal * Real.sqrt (2 * (1 - (μ S).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ y in S, inner ℝ (ν y) e ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
